limitations: The product of shares is a conditional calculation only if both publisher percentages share compatible deduplicated denominators; this has not been independently verified.
A buyer address is not a verified unique customer or person; the top service is imported and concentration could include non-organic activity.
Overlapping 30-day windows are not independent cohorts; changing coverage and directory membership prevent causal or acquisition inference.
This is not total x402 market volume, independently verified sales, AgentMine revenue, conversion or margin.
One-address flow may also appear in other services; residual is only a conditional upper bound outside that address, not organic spend.
decision_implication: Do not use gross reported x402 flow as AgentMine transaction-fee TAM. Validate service-level buyer independence and provenance before choosing a fee business.
